name: Cisco Ready: Part Serial Number Search
description: Search for and retrieve part/device serial number details from Cisco Ready. Enter a serial number to look up device information, configuration, warranty status, and support history. Provides complete hardware asset details for a specific part.

steps.description: Navigate to Cisco Ready SN Search page
Wait for radio button to become visible
Click on radio button: Serial Number Search
Wait for page to process radio selection and field to be ready
Enter serial number into search field
steps.param_description: Serial number of the part/device to search for in Cisco Ready

steps.description: Wait for search results grid to be populated

outputs.name: search_results
outputs.label: Search Results
outputs.js: (function() { var result = { columns: [], rows: [], rowCount: 0, success: false, debug: {}, error: null }; try { result.debug.timestamp = new Date().toISOString(); var root = document.querySelector('.ag-root'); result.debug.agRootFound = !!root; if (!root) root = document.querySelector('[role="grid"]'); result.debug.roleGridFound = !!root; if (!root) { var allAg = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="ag-"]'); result.debug.elementsWithAgClass = allAg.length; if (allAg.length > 0) root = allAg[0].closest('.ag-root, [role="grid"]'); } result.debug.rootElement = root ? 'found' : 'NOT FOUND'; if (!root) { result.error = 'ag-grid root element not found'; return result; } var headerCells = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[role="columnheader"]')); result.debug.headerCellsFound = headerCells.length; var headers = []; headerCells.forEach(function(cell) { var text = (cell.textContent || cell.innerText || '').trim(); if (text) headers.push(text); }); result.columns = headers; result.debug.columnNames = headers; var allRows = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[role="row"]')); result.debug.totalRowsFound = allRows.length; var dataRows = []; allRows.forEach(function(row) { var isHeaderRow = !!row.querySelector('[role="columnheader"]'); if (!isHeaderRow) { var cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('[role="gridcell"]')); var rowData = cells.map(function(cell) { return (cell.textContent || cell.innerText || '').trim(); }); if (rowData.some(function(v) { return v.length > 0; })) { dataRows.push(rowData); } } }); result.rows = dataRows; result.rowCount = dataRows.length; result.success = headers.length > 0 && dataRows.length > 0; result.debug.dataRowsFound = dataRows.length; if (!result.success) { result.debug.whyFailed = (headers.length === 0 ? 'no headers ' : '') + (dataRows.length === 0 ? 'no data rows' : ''); } } catch(e) { result.error = 'Exception: ' + e.toString(); result.debug.exception = true; } return result; })()
outputs.parse_instructions:
Format the search results EXACTLY as follows. Start with '## Cisco Ready Search Results'. On next line: '**Total Results:** N' (where N is the rowCount). Then for EACH row: blank line, then '### Result X of Y', then EACH FIELD on its own line as '**FieldName:** fieldvalue'. Do NOT use semicolons or equals signs. Put each field on a NEW LINE. Use the columns array to get field names in order, then match values from results_data in the same position. Example: 
## Cisco Ready Search Results
**Total Results:** 1

### Result 1 of 1
**Sales Level 6:** STR_DT_HUNGARY_HUN
**SAV Name:** MAGYAR TELEKOM
**SAVM Group ID:** 227847508
**Active SAV:** Y

fields.name: search_results_formatted
fields.description: Human-readable formatted results with column names paired with values for each row

fields.name: success
fields.description: Whether search was successful and returned data
